visuals.title: Find the right-breast UOQ
visuals.prompt: On the left schematic (right breast, facing patient), select the upper outer quadrant label region (lateral/axillary side).

hotspots.neutralLabel: Region A, upper-left area of the left schematic (toward axilla)
Region B, upper-right area of the left schematic (toward midline)
Region C, lower-left area of the left schematic

feedback.a: Correct. Outer/lateral on the right breast is toward the axilla (outside of the page).
feedback.b: That is UIQ (upper inner / toward midline).
feedback.d: The center marker is the nipple/central region.

visuals.explanation: SEER names UOQ as upper outer quadrant. Match the label on the correct laterality schematic.
visuals.accessibilityNote: Regions described by position on the left (right-breast) schematic until reveal.

glossary.definition: Fibrous connective tissue plus glandular tissue (ducts and lobules).
In its original place; abnormal cells have not spread from where they formed.
First lymph node to which cancer is likely to spread from a primary tumor.
Abnormal cells in a breast duct lining that have not spread outside the duct.
Connective-tissue bands connecting breast tissue to the overlying dermis.
